v1 97.066/97.058. THE ROOM TURNS: hypnotic driving techno at 134 bpm in D minor, No Floor's drive in another style (no acid), on my analog drum-machine voices (machine-kit, now in the groove).
- THE ORBITS (a space illusion): the rim, the clap, the ride and the cowbell circle the listener. Each pans on a slow song-time LFO while a second LFO a quarter-cycle behind darkens, quiets and wets it as it passes behind you, so it is heard going round, not side to side. Orbits: rim every 3 bars, clap 5, ride 7, cowbell 5 on the far side.
- The rumble kick on every beat, with the hard kick layered on the ones at the peaks and on every beat in the last.
- A boom bass (the machine's 808 boom played as a bass line) galloping on every off-beat, pumped by the kick.
- A D minor stab whose band-pass breathes on a 5-bar LFO, into a dotted echo.
- Form: in the break the orbits speed to a bar a turn. THE STOP: the kick and hats drop out and every orbiting voice is dry and dead centre at your ear. Then the room TURNS BACK the other way for the peak.
Few parts: the motion is the hypnosis. (Not queued.) Flow in from t4 is 6.6: t4 ends about 47 dB below my opening.
next: Ears on the orbit depth (is the going-round heard?). Flow into t4/t6 once those settle.
